articles.content: Narrative and qualifications reviewed: Ludin’s Reports are three Holy Nation patrol records about The Hub. To find them, look for the one Small Shack that is still intact among the ruins. All three reports and both priests’ notes are inside. Report I Commander Nix sends High Paladin Ludin to investigate The Hub. The patrol finds burned buildings on the verge of collapse and gaps in the town walls. There are no enemy soldiers or bodies in sight. Ludin thinks the Shek occupied the town for some time, but he cannot explain why they left. In his judgment, the Holy Nation could take possession of the ruins easily. Making the town habitable again would be the harder task. Report II At dusk, Paladin Lusac’s hound spots figures on the hill, breaks free and chases them into The Hub. By the time the patrol reaches the ruins, the figures and the hound have disappeared. Open doors and objects moved from their places convince Ludin that someone has been there. He suspects Shek scouts and recommends sending patrols farther south. He also asks that Lusac be given leave after losing his hound. Report III On a night patrol, Ludin hears voices outside the walls. They fall silent as his squad passes through the gate. While Ludin searches the bar, he hears Sentinel Amphetio scream. The patrol finds neither Amphetio nor any sign of a struggle and withdraws. Ludin now calls the figures wraiths and urges the Holy Nation to burn what remains of The Hub. Who the patrol heard and what happened to Amphetio remain open questions. The priests’ notes Priest Varloo’s Note blames Narko for the Holy Nation’s losses and argues that it cannot hold The Hub. Priest Tyluig’s Note agrees about abandoning the town but puts the blame on the Holy Nation’s own people for losing their faith. The three in-game reports can be read in the Fandom transcription of Ludin’s Reports, revision 90111.

articles.content: Narrative and qualifications reviewed: Kenshi takes place on an unnamed tidally locked moon, with a history spanning several thousand years. Much of it is shrouded in mystery, with legends, lies, and myths mixed in with the historical records. This is a vague timeline of events we know to have happened, sorted very loosely categorized to chronological order as close as possible with our limited knowledge. Much of the information on this page is speculative and should not be considered 100% accurate. SPOILER ALERT! Timeline The Ancients (Likely Many Thousands of Years Ago): The First Empire - A powerful and technologically advanced civilization, possessing automated factories, satellites, genetic engineering, giant robots, and space elevators. Unknown how long they existed, what came before them, how far their reach extended, or if they were even from Kenshi’s world or not; regardless, they were advanced to the point of godlike levels compared to the modern times. Possible rusted remains of spacecraft can be found around the continent. It is possible that the large industrial remains in Floodlands and Deadlands are the result of this civilization. The War of Behemoths - At some point, a war broke out between the First Empire and an unclear enemy either internal or external. The war used weapons so powerful that their owners began to fear the consequences of using them, such as the Behemoths, giant Skeletons that tower several times the height over usual individuals. Obedience - Due to their fear of the Behemoths, the Ancients decided to dispose of them after the war. Utilizing their unquestioning loyalty, the Ancients ordered the Behemoths down into a massive pit with molten metal that encased them permanently. The Chaos Age and the fall of First Empire - A time of many calamities, rumored to be from dangerous celestial activity, to natural disasters, to plagues, to even a skeleton rebellion. It’s unclear exactly what happened, or if this happened before or after the events of Obedience, possibly even spanning across the entirety of the event. But the First Empire had ceased to exist in a form recognizable as before and fallen. Second Empire (Approximately 1000+ Years Ago) The Second Empire is Founded. Sometime after the Chaos Age, to redeem themselves in the eyes of humanity for their actions of the past (though the humans had long since forgotten)[1], Cat-Lon and his Skeleton followers founded an empire. They attempted to rebuild civilization and study the remains of the Ancient Empire. The formation of Hydraulic Knights. At some point, and for reasons unknown (even Skeleton characters themselves claim that they do not know), the humans in the northwest developed a taste for human flesh. Cat-Lon’s empire spent a fair number of resources combating them, including the formation of a militant group known as the Hydraulic Knights. These knights would combat the external enemies of the empire, such as pirates and cannibals. The cannibal tribes have legends that speak of a skeleton warrior they know as “The Inedible One.” It is highly likely that this warrior was a member of the Hydraulic Knights, possibly their leader General Jang. The Empire starts to Crumble. While initially founded with good intentions, to keep the peace, the empire became more and more dictatorial[2]. Child prisons, crackdowns on piracy and religious cults, and the killing of many of their own innocent citizens in the process much-inflamed tensions amongst the human populace[3]. The Second Empire’s military began decapitating dissident skeletons, enthralling all traitors who sided with the humans[4]. When a great famine hit, the empire neared its breaking point[5]. (+5000 years ago) The Founding of the Holy Nation. While details from this time are sparse (and rarely trustworthy), legends say it was around this time that a great leader of humanity stepped forward and gathered his followers in rebellion. Legends call him the Phoenix, champion of the god Okran and possessor of the everlasting Holy Flame. He united the humans in a movement that eventually went on to found one of the oldest living civilizations to this day, The Holy Nation. The Fall of the Second Empire. It is unclear what actually caused the fall of the empire, although it is suggested to be a multitude of factors, ranging from famine[5], human rebellion and Skeleton treason[4]. Regardless, the empire gradually decayed and collapsed. Their leaders retreated into the dangerous Ashlands, where they reside to this day. Intermediate Period (Approximately 100-1000 Years Ago) (1000 years ago) setting of Kenshi 2 (937 years ago) Armour King founds his shop. Appearance of the Hivers. It is unclear when or how the Hivers appeared, or if they were present during the time of First or Second Empire. Whether they originated/mutated from humans or came from a land across the seas, they appeared and have been a resident of our lands ever since. The Rise and Fall of Kral. For as long as anyone can remember, the Shek were simple tribes living in the wilderness, divided and warring regularly. At one point, a great Shek warrior named Kral unified the tribes into a powerful kingdom, taught his followers a code of honor and strength, and led them into a march of conquest. Eventually, however, he was slain in battle against an enemy force that legends say outnumbered him a hundredfold. After his death, he attained near godlike levels of worship from his followers, who want nothing more than to die in a great battle like him. As such, they have continued their raiding and warlike ways with their neighbours ever since. Appearance of the Modern Shek. While it is likely the Shek existed during Cat-Lon’s empire, and possibly even back to the days of Ancients or First Empire, they did not have the appearance they currently sport. Their previous appearance was much more similar to a standard human, as they lacked the horns they are known for, and were known as Enforcers. It is unknown what role they played in the empires of old, though given the name it is possible they were a soldier or law enforcement caste, dedicated to fighting their master’s enemies. The Birth of the United Cities and the Traders Guild. It is unclear when or how United Cities and Traders Guild came into being, but it is possible they were formed in the ashes of a former empire. Whether this was the Second Empire itself or another one is unknown, but the United Cities and the Traders Guild seized power and ruled as powerful entities ever since. During the formative years of the United Cities, anti-government rebels invented Spring Bat crossbows to counter the Empire’s heavy Samurai. Recent History (0-100 Years Ago) As is Holy Nation tradition, the 62nd Phoenix was taken from his birth parents shortly after his birth and raised in isolation by the High Priest. There he was indoctrinated into the Okranite religion and taught all the skills he needed in order to rule the empire. The 62nd Phoenix is said to be one of the harshest Phoenixes in the Holy Nation’s history, having judged his own family at the age of 16, sentencing them to be purged in Holy Fire. Ever since, Holy Lord Phoenix has championed the unrelenting will of Okran. The Red Rebellion and the ascendance of Tengu. A few decades ago, the southern plains suffered a significant drought, which in turn caused a severe famine that nearly brought the United Cities to its collective knees. Due to the famine, the southern cities were forced to rely on the Traders’ Guild to bring them the supplies they needed to survive. Unfortunately, bandits and Shek raiders blockaded the routes and took these supplies for themselves. What little did get through was instantly set upon by the nobles in a bidding war, and the lower classes were driven to starvation and rebellion. The resultant fighting claimed many lives, including many nobles and even Emperor Anzai himself, but the rebels were eventually put down and survivors enslaved. This marked the selection of a new Emperor from the Noble’s Circle, Emperor Tengu, a cruel and impulsive man known for his lack of common sense. As a result, the poor and downtrodden are now even more heavily oppressed, even being arrested and sold into slavery for merely being poor as they are seen as a threat to the stability of the empire itself. The destruction of Bast. Bast was once a growing area of the United Cities, filled with many hamlets and towns for trading. However, everything changed when the Holy Nation attacked, who proceeded to burn the namesake city to the ground and haul the youngsters off to Rebirth. The land has been a warzone where both the Holy Nation and United cities fight endlessly in the region, trampling underfoot any life that may have once thrived here. Revenge of Luquin. Luquin and his family were sold into slavery at a young age, where they were subjected to beatings, starvation, and exhaustion from working in the mines. Eventually, his father would succumb to the horrid conditions, devastating both Luquin and his mother, who, with nothing left to lose, devised an escape plan to save her son. She succeeded in freeing him, but at the cost of her own life. Starving and alone in the desert at the age of 15, he was found and taken in by a clan of ninjas who trained him in the arts of stealth and assassination. Seven years later, he returned to his hometown for blood, using his skills to stalk and assassinate noble after noble. Eventually, Luquin was arrested and paraded through the streets as a criminal before being sent off to Tengu’s Vault, where he was subjected to many tortures, including being forced to write a book in tribute to Emperor Tengu. Overthrow of King Shager. Shager was the latest in the line of Kings from the Shek Kingdom. Like most Shek, he saw battle as a point of honor, with death in battle being the highest of honors. Under his rule, the Shek Kingdom was crumbling under the loss of life sustained in their wars with the Holy nation and the United Cities. King Shager proposed a desperate, suicidal last stand with whatever weakened warriors were left. To this, the warrior Bayan spoke up, protesting against throwing away their lives needlessly. Shager was furious, but one of the Invincible Five, Esata the Stone Golem, stepped between the two and shouted, “the man speaks the truth. You want Bayan silenced; you’ll have to cut me down first”. Their swords crossed, and that day marked the beginning of the Stone Golem’s rule, with Bayan at her side. She pulled her warriors off the front lines, made peace with the United Cities, and opened her borders to trade from the other races. Despite protests from some of her warriors, she is determined to ensure her people survive into the future, even if it means tearing down some of their long-held ideals and traditions. Unclear Chronological Order Stobe dies: Stobe’s Gamble and Stobe’s Garden are named after him; the latter is where he lays dead. Fogmen Infestation: For whatever reason, a cousin Hive civilization next to the Western Hive lost its mind and became roaming Fogmen inside the Fog Islands. Causing The Holy Nation to be wary of their existence[7]. Waterlevels Change: It is heavily hinted that the water levels were higher by hundreds of meters long time ago, during the time of Old Empire[8] The Eyes were large, destructive satellite-like structures that brought death and destruction whereever they went. At least one of them has become defunct and lays mostly inactive in The Eye, whereas at least one other is still running in Venge. Mass Suicide of Skeletons: The vast majority of Skeleton remains found by Tech Hunters suggest that they all died from suicide[9], exact cause unknown.

articles.content: Narrative and qualifications reviewed: Kenshi ismi verilmeyen ve kütleçekim kilidine sahip bir uyduda geçer ve birkaç bin yıllık bir tarihe sahiptir. Bu tarihin büyük bir kısmı gizemle örtülüdür; efsaneler, yalanlar ve mitler tarihi kayıtlarla birbirine karışmıştır. Aşağıdaki liste, yaşandığını bildiğimiz olayların, kısıtlı bilgimizle olabildiğince kronolojik sıraya göre çok gevşek bir şekilde kategorize edilmiş belirsiz bir zaman çizelgesidir. Bu sayfadaki bilgilerin çoğu spekülatiftir ve %100 doğru olarak kabul edilmemelidir. SPOILER UYARISI! Zaman Çizelgesi Kadimler (Muhtemelen Binlerce Yıl Önce): İlk İmparatorluk (The First Empire) - Otomatik fabrikalara, uydulara, genetik mühendisliğe, dev robotlara ve uzay asansörlerine sahip, güçlü ve teknolojik açıdan gelişmiş bir medeniyet. Ne kadar süre var oldukları, onlardan önce ne olduğu, ne kadar geniş bir alana yayıldıkları ya da Kenshi dünyasından olup olmadıkları bilinmiyor; ne olursa olsun, modern zamanlara kıyasla tanrısal seviyelere kadar gelişmişlerdi. Kıtanın etrafında uzay araçlarına ait olabilecek paslanmış kalıntılar bulunabilir. Floodlands ve Deadlands’teki devasa sanayi kalıntılarının bu medeniyetin eseri olması muhtemeldir. Behemoth Savaşı - Geçmişte bir noktada, İlk İmparatorluk ile iç veya dış olduğu belirsiz bir düşman arasında bir savaş patlak verdi. Bu savaşta o kadar güçlü silahlar kullanıldı ki, sahipleri dahi onları kullanmanın sonuçlarından korkmaya başladı. Standart bireylerin birkaç katı uzunluğunda devasa İskeletler (Skeleton) olan Behemoth’lar da bu silahlardan biriydi. Obedience (İtaat) - Kadimler, Behemoth’lara duydukları korku nedeniyle, savaş bittikten sonra onlardan kurtulmaya karar verdiler. Onların sorgusuz sualsiz sadakatlerini kullanan Kadimler, Behemoth’lara erimiş metalle dolu devasa bir çukura inmelerini emretti ve onları oraya sonsuza dek hapsetti. Kaos Çağı ve İlk İmparatorluğun Çöküşü - Tehlikeli göksel aktivitelerden doğal afetlere, salgın hastalıklardan bir iskelet isyanına kadar pek çok felaketin yaşandığı söylenen bir dönem. Tam olarak ne olduğu veya bunun Obedience olayından önce mi yoksa sonra mı yaşandığı (hatta olayın tamamına yayılıp yayılmadığı) belirsizdir. Ancak İlk İmparatorluk, eskiden bilinen haliyle var olmayı bırakmış ve çökmüştür. İkinci İmparatorluk (Yaklaşık 1000+ Yıl Önce) İkinci İmparatorluğun Kurulması. Kaos Çağı’ndan bir süre sonra, (insanlar çoktan unutmuş olsa da) geçmişteki eylemlerinden dolayı insanlığın gözünde kendilerini aklamak için“Eski İmparatorluğun kurucu iskeletlerinden biri olarak, İskelet ırkının suçlarını ve hatalarını geri almayı ve insanlık çoktan unutmuş olsa da kendilerini onlara affettirmeyi amaçlıyorlardı.” - CPU of Cat-Lon, Cat-Lon ve onun İskelet takipçileri bir imparatorluk kurdu. Medeniyeti yeniden inşa etmeye ve Kadim İmparatorluğun kalıntılarını incelemeye çalıştılar. Hidrolik Şövalyelerin Kurulması. Bilinmeyen bir zamanda ve bilinmeyen nedenlerle (İskelet karakterlerin kendileri bile bilmediklerini iddia ederler), kuzeybatıdaki insanlar insan etine tat duymaya başladı. Cat-Lon’un imparatorluğu, korsanlar ve yamyamlar gibi dış düşmanlarla savaşacak olan ve Hidrolik Şövalyeler (Hydraulic Knights) olarak bilinen militan bir grubun kurulması da dahil olmak üzere, onlarla savaşmak için oldukça fazla kaynak harcadı. Yamyam kabilelerin, “Yenilemez Olan” olarak bildikleri bir iskelet savaşçısından bahseden efsaneleri vardır. Bu savaşçının Hidrolik Şövalyelerin bir üyesi, muhtemelen liderleri General Jang olması kuvvetle muhtemeldir. İmparatorluk Çökmeye Başlıyor. Başlangıçta barışı korumak için iyi niyetlerle kurulmuş olsa da, imparatorluk giderek daha diktatörleşti“Sonunda bir diktatör oldu, imparatorluk parçalanmaya başladıkça onu zorla bir arada tutmaya çalıştı.” - CPU of Cat-Lon. Çocuk hapishaneleri, korsanlara ve dini tarikatlara yönelik baskılar ve bu süreçte kendi masum vatandaşlarının birçoğunun öldürülmesi, insan halkı arasındaki gerilimi büyük ölçüde körükledi“Zaman geçtikçe ‘korsan’ yaftası daha da yersiz bir şekilde kullanılmaya başlandı ve gerçek korsanlardan çok kendi insanlarını öldürdüklerini fark ettiler.” - CPU of General Jang. İkinci İmparatorluğun ordusu muhalif iskeletlerin kafalarını kesmeye ve insanlardan yana olan tüm hainleri köleleştirmeye başladı“Hepsini köleleştirmek zorundaydım! İnsanların tarafını tutan hainler! İhanet!” - Mad Cat-Lon. Büyük bir kıtlık vurduğunda, imparatorluk kırılma noktasına geldi“Olanları asla öngöremezdi ama yine de kıtlık ve imparatorluğun müteakip çöküşü için kendini suçladı” - CPU of the Head of Agriculture. (+5000 yıl önce) Kutsal Ulus’un (The Holy Nation) Kurulması. Bu döneme ait detaylar seyrek (ve nadiren güvenilir) olsa da, efsaneler bu sıralarda insanlığın büyük bir liderinin öne çıkıp takipçilerini bir isyanda topladığını söyler. Efsaneler onu Okran tanrısının şampiyonu ve sönmez Kutsal Ateş’in sahibi Phoenix“En karanlık anlarımızda en parlak ışık, Phoenix geldi. Okran bize inancımızı geri getirecek ve Gölgeyi defedecek şampiyonunu göndermişti. Phoenix, İnsanın bir kez daha özgür yaşayacağının vaadi olan sonsuz Kutsal Ateş ile geldi. Bizi hem prangalardan hem de canavarlıktan kurtardı ve Kutsal Bağlar ile birleştirdi.” - Scripture of Radiance II olarak adlandırır. İnsanları, bugüne kadar yaşayan en eski uygarlıklardan biri olan The Holy Nation’ı (Kutsal Ulus) kuracak bir harekette birleştirdi. İkinci İmparatorluğun Yıkılışı. Kıtlık, insan isyanı ve İskelet ihaneti gibi çok sayıda faktörün olduğu öne sürülse de, imparatorluğun çöküşüne neyin sebep olduğu belirsizdir. Ne olursa olsun, imparatorluk yavaş yavaş çürüdü ve çöktü. Liderleri, bugüne kadar ikamet ettikleri tehlikeli Ashlands’e (Kül Diyarı) çekildiler. Ara Dönem (Yaklaşık 100-1000 Yıl Önce) (1000 yıl önce) Kenshi 2’nin geçtiği zaman (937 yıl önce) Armour King dükkanını kurdu. Hiver’ların (Kovan Irkı) Ortaya Çıkışı. Hiver’ların ne zaman ve nasıl ortaya çıktıkları veya İlk veya İkinci İmparatorluk zamanında var olup olmadıkları belirsizdir. İster insanlardan türemiş/mutasyona uğramış olsunlar, ister denizlerin ötesindeki bir diyardan gelmiş olsunlar, ortaya çıktılar ve o zamandan beri topraklarımızın bir sakini oldular. Kral’ın Yükselişi ve Düşüşü. Shekler, bilindiği kadarıyla vahşi doğada yaşayan, bölünmüş ve düzenli olarak savaşan basit kabilelerdi. Bir noktada, Kral adında büyük bir Shek savaşçısı kabileleri güçlü bir krallıkta birleştirdi, takipçilerine bir onur ve güç kodu öğretti ve onları bir fetih yürüyüşüne çıkardı. Ancak sonunda, efsanelere göre kendisinden yüz kat daha kalabalık bir düşman kuvvetine karşı girdiği bir savaşta katledildi. Ölümünden sonra, onun gibi büyük bir savaşta ölmekten başka bir şey istemeyen takipçilerinden neredeyse tanrısal düzeyde bir tapınma gördü. Bu nedenle, o zamandan beri komşularıyla baskın ve savaşçı yollarına devam ediyorlar. Modern Shek’in Ortaya Çıkışı. Shek’lerin Cat-Lon’un imparatorluğu sırasında, hatta Kadimler veya İlk İmparatorluk dönemine kadar var oldukları muhtemel olsa da, şu anki görünümlerine sahip değillerdi. Sahip oldukları boynuzlardan yoksun oldukları için önceki görünümleri çok daha standart bir insana benziyordu ve Enforcer (İnfazcı) olarak biliniyorlardı. Eski imparatorluklarda nasıl bir rol oynadıkları bilinmemekle birlikte, isimleri göz önüne alındığında, ustalarının düşmanlarıyla savaşmaya adanmış bir asker veya kolluk kuvveti kastı olmaları muhtemeldir. Birleşik Şehirlerin (United Cities) ve Tüccarlar Loncasının (Traders Guild) Doğuşu. United Cities ve Traders Guild’in ne zaman ve nasıl ortaya çıktığı belirsizdir, ancak eski bir imparatorluğun küllerinden kurulmuş olmaları muhtemeldir. Bunun İkinci İmparatorluğun kendisi mi yoksa başka bir imparatorluk mu olduğu bilinmiyor, ancak Birleşik Şehirler ve Tüccarlar Loncası iktidarı ele geçirdi ve o zamandan beri güçlü varlıklar olarak hüküm sürüyorlar. Birleşik Şehirlerin kuruluş yıllarında, hükümet karşıtı isyancılar, İmparatorluğun ağır Samurai’larına karşı koymak için Spring Bat arbaletlerini icat etti. Yakın Tarih (0-100 Yıl Önce) Kutsal Ulus geleneği olduğu üzere, 62. Phoenix doğumundan kısa bir süre sonra öz anne babasından alınmış ve Başrahip tarafından tecrit altında yetiştirilmiştir. Orada Okran dininin doktrinleri aşılandı ve imparatorluğu yönetmek için ihtiyaç duyduğu tüm beceriler öğretildi. 16 yaşındayken kendi ailesini yargılayıp Kutsal Ateş’te arınmalarına (yakılmalarına) hükmeden 62. Phoenix’in, Kutsal Ulus tarihinin en acımasız Phoenix’lerinden biri olduğu söylenir. O zamandan beri Kutsal Lord Phoenix, Okran’ın amansız iradesinin şampiyonluğunu yapmaktadır. Kızıl İsyan (Red Rebellion) ve Tengu’nun Yükselişi. Birkaç on yıl önce, güney düzlükleri önemli bir kuraklık yaşadı ve bu da Birleşik Şehirleri (United Cities) neredeyse dizlerinin üzerine çöktüren şiddetli bir kıtlığa neden oldu. Kıtlık nedeniyle güneydeki şehirler hayatta kalmak için ihtiyaç duydukları malzemeleri getirmesi için Tüccarlar Loncası’na (Traders Guild) güvenmek zorunda kaldı. Ne yazık ki haydutlar ve Shek akıncıları yolları kapattı ve bu malzemeleri kendilerine aldılar. Ulaşabilen çok az şey, bir ihale savaşında soylular tarafından anında kapışıldı ve alt sınıflar açlığa ve isyana sürüklendi. Sonuçta ortaya çıkan çatışmalar, birçok soylu ve hatta Emperor Anzai’nin (İmparator Anzai) kendisi de dahil olmak üzere birçok can aldı, ancak isyancılar sonunda bastırıldı ve hayatta kalanlar köleleştirildi. Bu durum, Soylu Halkasından sağduyu eksikliğiyle bilinen, zalim ve fevri bir adam olan Emperor Tengu’nun (İmparator Tengu) yeni bir İmparator olarak seçilmesine işaret ediyordu. Sonuç olarak, fakirler ve ezilenler artık daha da ağır bir şekilde ezilmekte, imparatorluğun istikrarına bir tehdit olarak görüldükleri için sadece fakir oldukları için bile tutuklanıp köleliğe satılmaktadır. Bast’ın Yıkımı. Bast, bir zamanlar Birleşik Şehirlerin (United Cities) ticaret için birçok mezra ve kasabayla dolu, büyüyen bir bölgesiydi. Ancak, Kutsal Ulus’un (Holy Nation) saldırıp aynı adı taşıyan şehri yerle bir etmesi ve gençleri Rebirth’e sürüklemesiyle her şey değişti. Bu topraklar, hem Kutsal Ulus’un hem de Birleşik Şehirlerin bölgede durmaksızın savaştığı, bir zamanlar burada gelişmiş olabilecek her türlü yaşamı ayaklar altına aldığı bir savaş alanına dönüştü. Luquin’in İntikamı. Luquin ve ailesi genç yaşta köleliğe satılmış ve burada madenlerde çalışmaktan dolayı dayak, açlık ve bitkinliğe maruz kalmışlardır. Sonunda babası bu korkunç koşullara yenik düşmüş ve hiçbir kaybedecek şeyi kalmayan annesiyle Luquin yıkılmıştır. Annesi oğlunu kurtarmak için bir kaçış planı tasarlamış, onu kurtarmayı başarmış ancak kendi hayatını kaybetmiştir. 15 yaşında çölde aç ve yalnız kalan Luquin, onu bulup gizlilik ve suikast sanatlarında eğiten bir ninja klanı tarafından yanlarına alındı. Yedi yıl sonra kan dökmek için memleketine döndü ve yeteneklerini soylu üstüne soyluyu takip edip suikast düzenlemek için kullandı. Sonunda Luquin tutuklandı ve Tengu’nun Mahzenine (Tengu’s Vault) gönderilmeden önce bir suçlu olarak sokaklarda teşhir edildi; burada İmparator Tengu’ya atfen bir kitap yazmaya zorlanmak da dahil olmak üzere pek çok işkenceye maruz kaldı. Kral Shager’in Devrilmesi. Shager, Shek Krallığı krallarının sonuncusuydu. Çoğu Shek gibi o da savaşı bir onur meselesi olarak görüyor, savaşta ölmeyi en büyük onur olarak kabul ediyordu. Onun yönetimi altında Shek Krallığı, Kutsal Ulus ve Birleşik Şehirler ile yaptıkları savaşlarda yaşanan can kayıpları altında eziliyordu. Kral Shager, zayıflamış savaşçılardan geriye kalanlarla umutsuz, intihar niteliğinde bir son direniş önerdi. Buna karşı savaşçı Bayan söz alarak hayatlarını gereksiz yere çöpe atmaya karşı çıktı. Shager çok öfkelendi, ancak Yenilmez Beşli’den (Invincible Five) biri olan Esata the Stone Golem (Taş Golem Esata) ikisinin arasına girdi ve şöyle bağırdı: “Adam doğruyu söylüyor. Bayan’ın susturulmasını istiyorsan önce beni kesmen gerekecek”. Kılıçları çarpıştı ve o gün Bayan’ın da yanında olduğu Taş Golem’in yönetiminin başlangıcı oldu. Savaşçılarını ön saflardan çekti, Birleşik Şehirler ile barış yaptı ve sınırlarını diğer ırkların ticaretine açtı. Bazı savaşçılarının protestolarına rağmen, uzun zamandır sahip oldukları bazı ideal ve gelenekleri yıkmak anlamına gelse bile, halkının gelecekte hayatta kalmasını sağlamaya kararlıdır. Belirsiz Kronolojik Sıra Stobe’nin Ölümü: Stobe’s Gamble ve Stobe’s Garden onun adını taşır; ikincisi onun ölü olarak yattığı yerdir. articles.content: Narrative and qualifications reviewed: Chitrin was a deity in the world of Kenshi whose story is described by the Book Of Sacrifice. He is a lesser-known deity with only a single book describing his existence, and the Holy Nation seemingly has banned his worship (although they have the Book of Sacrifice in their Temples). Outside of Holy Nation Temples, the book can also be found in the Flotsam Village which makes sense considering Moll’s open ideas on religion. History of Chitrin The book describes Chitrin as a benevolent god whose people lost faith in him one day. As the faith in Chitrin diminished, his power decreased and the lands were plagued by calamities. The people begged Chitrin to save them. In an act of forgiveness, Chitrin sacrificed himself to end the calamities and was reborn as Okran, the god of day, warmth, and renewal, and Narko, the god of night, cold, and destruction. From then on, the two deities lived on in balance. Trivia Some players believe Chitrin may have some connection to another lore character, Stobe.

articles.content: Narrative and qualifications reviewed: This Page details the various notable events related to the Phoenixes of different generations. Phoenix the First Founder of The Holy Nation. Author of Scripture of Radiance Series. Claimed that his soul will be reincarnated into the next first born male, therefore creating the lineage of Phoenixes. Declared Phoenix to be the champion sent by Okran, “one that would restore our faith and banish the Shadow” in his own words. Holy Lord Phoenix IV Author of Birth Of The Phoenix, declared Phoenix’s soul as an extension of Okran and therefore divinely pure and incorruptible, as well as proclaiming that only the Phoenix can be the one to guide their faith. Holy Lord Phoenix XLVII Alleged manufacturer of Chalice Of Fire. Holy Lord Phoenix LXII The current Phoenix where the players story takes place. Sentenced his own family to be executed at the age of 16. Author of Holy Edict and The Holy Crusade. Said to be one of the harshest in the line of Phoenixes. Likely to be the leader that successfully managed to soundly defeat the Shek Kingdom and declare war on United Cities. Smells of vegetables. Trivia The average lifespan (or the time until next reincarnation, if you will) of a Phoenix is around 80.6 years. This takes into account that the Holy Nation has a history of around 5000 years divided by 62. This is way above the average lifespan for people living in a post-apocalypse world. There is a possibility that the reason of why Phoenixes can manage to live that long is because of the HN’s advanced medicinal technology (in contrast to the otherwise low-tech nature of nearly all other aspects of their country). The evidence that supports the theory that HN has advanced medicinal technology is given that HN has doctors and surgeons in their country while other countries don’t and also that Lord Phoenix LXII’s inventory includes Advanced First Aid Kit and Advanced Splint Kit.

Born out of the darkest depths of the world came Narko, the Shadow.She sought to erase all that is good, if not for our saviour Okran. Both battled for millenia in the skies until light overcame dark. Narko was restrained, absorbed into the Lord Okran's being. But, alas, Narko The Deceiver's defeat was not the end. While both fought their war in the skies, split in two once again, Narko's spawns were ravaging our world, created out of hate and malice. Against mankind, her Dark Agents were hurled.Scripture of Radiance Vol. I, Holy Lord Phoenix I History of Narko Narko, a deity described as the demoness of darkness. She is the dark counterpart to Okran said to be cast out into the underworld. Each one is equally regarded as cruel, narcissistic, and incompetent. Each noble is followed by an elite samurai bodyguard. They can be seen harassing peasants in cities and hinterland if one is unlucky enough to mistakenly block their path. For players attempting to stand up to a noble in any way, note that by choosing any hostile or insulting dialogue options, the nobles will send their guards after you and a bounty will be put on your head. Each noble in the United Cities has diplomatic status, and choosing to attack or kidnap a noble will land you with a high bounty for committing terrorism in addition to a great relation penalty. The Noble Circle is mentioned in the Legend of Luquin Series. The lore books Letter Of Parting, The Blessing Of Slavery, and The Red Rebellion are written by Nobles. articles.content: Narrative and qualifications reviewed: The Old Empire are the remains of the ancient civilization that once controlled the entire world. Their written language is now unrecognizable to modern eyes. What is left of their civilization are the scattered Lost Libraries and Armories around the world, where the player may find Ancient Science books, AI cores, robotic spiders and skeletons. How this mighty empire was destroyed is unknown, but it is speculated that it was their own weapon systems or possibly Skeletons that destroyed them. A successor empire simply known as the “Second Empire” sprang from the Old Empire’s ashes, notably being much smaller in scale and controlled by Skeletons. Trivia While this page refers to the “Old Empire” exclusively as the “First Empire”, There are several locations in Kenshi that have “Old Empire” in their name (i.e Old Empire Watchtower, Old Empire Supply Outpost) but have Second Empire as their faction label instead of The Old Empire (which is a cut-content faction). They could be named eponymously so because both civilizations are considered to be “Old” by modern standards, be it the “First Empire” or the “Second Empire”. Cat-Lon’s CPU description is an example of referring to “The Old Empire” as “Second Empire” and not the “First Empire”.

articles.content: Narrative and qualifications reviewed: Though it would seem they are uncultured, the Shek are deeply rooted in ancestral worship and respect. Despite their racist attitude towards non-Shek (except Skeletons, who come the closest to earning their respect as warriors), they are willing to accept and even worship you so long as you prove your worth in battle. This is confirmed by fighting and beating the Bugmaster or Lord Phoenix, which regardless of your race will make them praise your name and defend it to the death. The Shek revere a legendary warrior by the name of Kral, who supposedly fought against impossible odds (100 to 1 or so) in the field of battle. He was slain, but not before taking dozens of enemies with him, earning him entry to an afterlife known as the Gateway. It is here that warriors are said to reside alongside the legendary warrior, likely feasting to their hearts content and fighting for sport. Those that reject this way of life have their horns sawed off/filed down as a sign of dishonor, branding them a coward. This may be done on the field of battle or once they return from a great battle and survive without defeating their enemy. Oftentimes the Shek in question becomes a servant to the Empire, undertaking more menial tasks deemed unfit for a warrior. Bayan, who served as Esata’s right-hand man, is one such Shek that was stripped of his honor yet was pardoned by the Golem and allowed to live within the court. Though she rarely acknowledges his existence, she secretly admires his spirit, and he continues to work similarly to a steward or scribe. Though one can easily disregard the Shek as a species native to Kenshi, or the product of radioactive exposure, they are more likely closely related to humans; so close, one might be able to call them brothers and sisters. Some skeletons, whose exposure to the outside world has been limited since the Chaos Age, will react to the Shek with confusion, referring to them as “Enforcers”. This happens in multiple instances, with some even commenting that their character was always the same, but that their bone plates and spikes were more recent changes. This evidence that the Shek had been within ancient society and their bone plates and spikes being recent changes is also further reinforced in The Guiding Light IV, where Okranite theologians claimed that Sheks were created as a brother of Okran, however, due to their aggressive nature and rejection of Okran’s light they devolved and sprouted the horns similar to a wild beast. For this reason, it is reasonable to assume that in Ancient society, Shek were ‘evolved’ humans (either through genetic modification, which the Ancients surely possessed, or selective breeding) and served as the central authority of law and order. While the most prominent example of a Shek society would be the Shek Kingdom, it should also be noted that significant amount of Sheks live outside their influence (and may have never ever came into contact with them) forming communities/diasporas in cities or regions with different values. The most notable example of this would be the United Cities, where many Sheks can be found inside their culture, the most priveleged among them even obtaining the rank of Nobility. In these places, the Sheks are generally assimilated among the wider populace, making the culture of the Shek diluted. While Sheks are often seen as barbaric brutes, whether or not the Sheks actually have a greater warmongering tendency (as compared to other races) appears to be complex and nuanced, while the vast majority of Sheks who live in the Shek Kingdom clearly favor warrior culture, the ones who live outside their culture don’t exhibit any or as much aggressive tendencies. At the same time, even inside the United Cities, who unlike The Holy Nation, don’t have any ingrained racial policies, still come to see Sheks as contributors to increased violence in their cities as seen in United Weeklies, suggesting that the stereotype of Sheks being aggressive originates on some grounds of truth. Additionally, some traces of bloodlust[1] can still be found in Sheks who have no connection with SK, which would imply that the aggression isn’t cultural but innate or biological, this could make sense if they are genetically engineered specifically to be more warlike. It is therefore likely that while Sheks are capable of being productive and peaceful citizens like other races, they still generally - more or less - have greater aggressive tendencies compared to others, the tendency of which becomes especially pronounced when they are grouped together, the result of which - such as in the case of Shek Kingdom - results in a society that’s largely focused on martial prowess, fighting, and personal bravery.
